title: SPARCLE：通过对比语言嵌入实现说话者感知的对齐表示
summary: SPARCLE是一种说话者感知的字素表示模型，通过对比学习将字素与Wav2Vec2声学表示对齐，并融入说话者身份信息。在低资源文本转语音任务中，相比标准字素模型，词错误率降低一半。
summary_en: SPARCLE is a speaker-aware grapheme representation model that aligns graphemes with Wav2Vec2 acoustic representations via contrastive learning, conditioned on speaker identity. It halves word error rates in low-resource TTS compared to standard grapheme models.
